note: Synthetic policy reference for the classifier agent. Represents 'what a support team has already pre-approved the bot to discuss/handle without escalation' — the kind of reference doc that would live in a real team's knowledge base.

preApprovedDiscounts.description: Standard, published promotions the bot can discuss without triggering escalation. A question ABOUT these is routine. A request for something OUTSIDE these (bigger, one-off, unpublished) is discretionary and should still be flagged.
rules: Multi-item purchase discounts (e.g. 'discount if I buy 3+') are pre-approved and publicly listed — answering this is routine, not a proposed action requiring approval.
Any discount request tied to a complaint, a threat to leave a bad review, or a demand for compensation is discretionary and must still be flagged for human approval, regardless of size.

refundPolicy.description: The bot can never execute a refund itself under any circumstances — always flag. This is unconditional and not affected by policy context.
rules: All refund requests are always escalated with proposedAction=refund, no exceptions.
